name: ojee-console-native
description: Capacitor wrapper for the ojee-console shell. Points a native WebView at the tailnet origin — there is no second frontend.

scripts.add:ios: npm run configure && npx cap add ios
scripts.add:android: npm run configure && npx cap add android
scripts.sync: npm run configure && npx cap sync
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npx cap run android
